summary: Prevent unsupported multi-area service claims, route empty product observations to partner coverage, preserve customer anchor and acceptable nearby areas, and validate through adaptive return-only replay.
Implemented on fresh branch fix/runtime-v7-multilocation-service-grounding-20260916 from origin/product 71bdb9b; no deployment or live traffic mutation.

The failure generalized to collapsed location scope and insufficient product authority: model-proposed nearby areas could overwrite the customer anchor, one provider result could be restated too broadly, and a zero-card product observation could unlock slot progression.

Keep one canonical customer location anchor and separately typed acceptable service locations; require provider evidence for each queried area and usable product or typed schedule authority before slot lookup.

Adaptive return-only replay queried Rosario, Cavite despite model proposals for Dasmarinas; provider returned three options and deterministic output claimed only Rosario. Product search executed 265/50R20 with required NITTO and ALL_TERRAIN constraints and rendered no unsupported cards.

Focused integrated suite passed 862 tests and complete Runtime V7 suite passed 1772 tests. Synthetic Firestore saves completed in one attempt at approximately 192-245 ms; final replay turns stayed under 95 seconds and 2 million tokens, though 27-40 second handler latency remains an operational concern.

Required-brand presentation and image preference suppressed source-backed exact-size Nitto rows when terrain could not be verified or an API image was missing; one replay also showed that probabilistic extraction could omit explicit A/T.

Keep brand and exact size hard, permit only disclosed terrain/category relaxation, retain every source-backed option in text, require trusted media for visual choices, and restore explicit canonical terrain from the latest customer turn.

Final adaptive return-only replay executed NITTO plus 265/50R20 plus ALL_TERRAIN, emitted the partial-match disclosure first, listed all three Nitto exact-size products, rendered two trusted-image tracked cards, and saved each turn in one Firestore attempt within the 95-second and 2-million-token per-turn limits.
